displayIdentity.body: A community is told to stand together under opposition. Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News; having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.
